subject: [PATCH v3 5/8] nfsd: mark the delegation written on COPY/CLONE instead of stamping c/mtime

2026-11-09.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFSv4 server to mark a delegation as written on COPY/CLONE operations instead of updating the c/mtime attributes. This change ensures that the client's coarse timestamp does not interfere with the server's ability to update the ctime when the holder returns its times after DELEGRETURN. The patch also removes unnecessary code and updates various functions to handle this new behavior.
